_comment: Retired 2026-11-15. The 249 file-scoped grandfather entries that lived here exempted files from scanning by filename, not by violation: measured at 5ae980f4 they kept 203 of the 253 violating files (466 of 679 reasons) out of the count — the waiver-era report was 50 files / 213 reasons, the unwaived measurement is 253 / 679. Their one shared expiry (2026-12-31) also floored a daysRemaining<30 test into a hard build FAIL from 2026-12-01. The authority is now data/decision_binding_baseline.json (a count ratchet with provenance). This array stays empty on purpose: the loader is fail-closed on its presence, and an empty list is the honest statement that nothing is exempt from scanning. Do not add entries.
